title: ALERT MARK CLEARS TOP EDGE NAME
why: Clamping a bot alert mark to the top edge put it over the bot name.
now: At the top edge the bot nameplate steps down with its alert mark. Away from the edge their positions stay the same.

edits.replacement: var lift=spriteTop(ne)+8-alertTopShift(ne)/ZOOM();   // v28.xx (cw-cx-alerttop): the plate, crew block and health pip step down together only at the top edge
